# Lua 5.4.8 vendored source

This directory contains the Lua 5.4.8 core and standard-library C sources and headers from https://github.com/lua/lua/tree/v5.4.8.

- Upstream version: Lua 5.4.8
- License: MIT; see [LICENSE](LICENSE).
- Runtime sources are compiled into the Nexo-3D `lua` engine module.
- The standalone interpreter and compiler entry points (`lua.c`, `luac.c`) are intentionally not included.
